comment: Vehicle spawn catalog. Structure: factions -> { factionId -> { types -> { typeId -> { vehicles: [...] } } } }. Each vehicle is one spawnable entry: a display name, the vehicle-class id (drives motion/stats via data/vehicle_classes.json), and the client scene that renders it. Add factions, types, and vehicles freely — the editor panel (VehicleEditorPanel) reads and writes this file. domain is derived from the class id, so a type section's domain is implied by its vehicles' class_id.
